title: QUIZ - 82
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Determine the slope of a line from two identifiable points on its graph
questions.question: A line's graph passes through the grid points (8, 5) and (2, -8). What is the slope of the line as shown on the graph?
questions.explanation: Reading the rise over run between the two graphed points: (-8-5)/(2-8) = -13/-6.
questions.hint: Count the rise (vertical change) and run (horizontal change) between two clear points on the graph.

questions.learningObjective: Determine the slope of a line from two identifiable points on its graph

questions.hint: Count the rise (vertical change) and run (horizontal change) between two clear points on the graph.

questions.concept: Reading Points from a Linear Graph's Equation
questions.learningObjective: Determine a graphed line's y-value at a specific x-value using its equation
questions.question: A graphed line passes through the point (2, 21). If the line follows \( y = 6x + 9 \), what is the y-value when x = 2?
questions.explanation: Substituting x = 2 into y = 6x + 9: y = 6(2) + 9 = 21, matching the graphed point.
questions.hint: Substitute the given x-value into the line's equation to find the corresponding y-value.
